meta.name: changelog
meta.description: Generate weekly changelog entries for blog and all GitHub repos. Use when asked to summarize changes, update the changelog, or at the end of a productive week. Analyzes git history across repos and creates curated summaries with deep links.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动汇总多仓库 Git 历史生成周报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每周要手动整理多个仓库的变更记录
copy.tagline_en: Automatically summarize git history across repos for weekly reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually compile changelogs from multiple repos each week

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能分析 GitHub 仓库的 git 历史，生成每周变更日志，包含具体内容摘要和深度链接，并更新到 changelog 文件中。
howto.when: 当你要求总结近期变更、更新变更日志，或在一周工作结束时触发。

say.text: 总结一下这周我博客仓库的变更。
say.note: Claude 会分析最近7天的 git 提交并生成日志。

say.text: 更新本周的变更日志，包括所有 GitHub 仓库。
say.note: Claude 会扫描多个仓库并合并生成新条目。
Claude 会检查所有公开仓库并输出摘要。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze git history across GitHub repos, generate weekly changelog entries with specific content summaries and deep links, and update the changelog file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to summarize recent changes, update the changelog, or at the end of a productive week.

say_en.text: Summarize the changes in my blog repo this week.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the last 7 days of git commits and generate a log.

say_en.text: Update the changelog for this week, including all GitHub repos.
say_en.note: Claude will scan multiple repos and merge them into a new entry.
Claude will check all public repos and output a summary.
